amount.description: A cash issue's amount, or a conversion's carrying amount.

approval_id.description: The approval request waiting, if any.

approved_on.description: The day it was approved: it is never effective earlier.

checks.description: What stops it moving on now, in plain words.

effective_on.description: The day ACRA's register of members shows it.

entries.description: The entries it posted: a cash issue's or a conversion's, or the reversals of them.

evidence.description: How many files are attached and not removed.

movements.description: The holding movements it wrote once effective.

number.description: Its number, EQ-, given on its approval (FR-ORG-04).

paid.description: A cash issue not yet effective: what its subscriber's share application monies hold today (B.7); it becomes effective once they cover the amount.

parties.description: The holders it moves shares of or for: they never approve it (FM-9).

share_issue_id.description: A cash issue's row in the register of share issues.

status.description: Draft (✎); approved, waiting for ACRA's date; effective, its shares moved; or reversed.

version.description: Its version; it makes the ETag.
